facts.moon-face: A round yellow moon, like a sun, holds a crescent-shaped side profile of a face with its eyes closed.
facts.drops: Yellow, water-drop-like shapes fall below the moon.
facts.two-towers: A gray tower with a small window stands on each side.
facts.dog-wolf: A dog on the left and a wolf on the right lift their heads and howl at the moon.
facts.crayfish: A crayfish crawls out of the pool of water below.
facts.path: A path starting at the water's edge winds through the field between the two towers, all the way to the far mountains.
facts.blue-sky: The sky is a pale blue.

glosses.crayfish: A vague anxiety rising from the depths.
glosses.moon-face: Borrowed light, so everything looks hazy.

reversedGloss.waning: Anxiety and confusion lift, and outlines begin to show.
reversedGloss.internalized: An unspoken fear circles around inside.
reversedGloss.excess: Imagination grows, and anxiety covers reality.

misdescriptions.wrong: A scorpion crawls out of the water.
A scene of a pitch-dark night.
